_doc: threads[]: id, title, author, date, body, when (visibility), onRead { setFlag } (fires when the thread is opened, via State.tryUnlock), locked, posts[]. posts[]: author, date, body – each may be a string or [variants] (seed-chosen, stable). when on a post = appears only once the condition holds. author '__VANISH__' = the seed-chosen vanishing username (usernames.json); after found_contradiction it renders as [deleted user]. date 'rel:-3' = '3 minutes ago' relative to now.

threads.title: Why is everyone disappearing?
threads.author: lastlight
threads.body:
Serious question. My contact list had 40 people on it last month. Now it has 6 and four of them haven't logged in since the 9th.

The migration notice says 'a subset of accounts'. A subset. It's everyone I know.

threads.title: Server migration failure? Really?
threads.author: m_vasquez_88
threads.body:
Let's compare notes. The official notice (posted 04-11, 09:00) says accounts were lost DURING the migration.

My logs say my sister's account stopped responding on 04-09, 23:58. Two days BEFORE the migration window opened.

Explain that.

posts.author: tobias.k
posts.body: Same. Whole friend group went dark on the 9th. Migration notice came out on the 11th.

posts.author: hollow_node
posts.body: The newsletter from the 10th says 'expected downtime: none'. Then the notice on the 11th says 2.4 million accounts are 'dormant'. Which is it.

posts.author: ghost_in_the_wire
posts.body: "Estimated recovery window: 30 days." It's been 30 days. Nobody came back.

posts.author: m_vasquez_88
posts.body: And the userlist backup in the archive is from the 9th. Why would you back up the userlist two days before a migration and then lose 2.4 million accounts anyway?

posts.author: __VANISH__
posts.body: Because it wasn't a backup. It was a list.
